card.name: The Proboscis of Doom
card.power: Eavesdrop: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Groan loudly at what you see.
card.lore: As the body fails, the sensors expand. You will hear every insult whispered by the youth.

line: The Proboscis of Doom, Eavesdrop? You will hear every insult whispered by youth.

card.name: The Chatter-Chompers
card.power: Swap Equipment: Steal an item from a player. Give them "Gingivitis" in return.
card.lore: The indignity isn't losing your teeth; it's accidentally wearing your enemy's smile.

line: The Chatter-Chompers, Swap Equipment: steal item, give Gingivitis. Accidentally wearing your enemy's smile.

card.name: The Wrinkle-Storm
card.power: Collision: Destroy 1 Future Timeline card. Both players cry.
card.lore: If you do not complete the mission, you age instantly. The diaper remains constant.

line: The Wrinkle-Storm, Collision: do not complete mission, you age instantly. Diaper remains constant.

card.name: The Foliage of Shame
card.power: Clog: Block a pathway. No one moves until you are surgically removed.
card.lore: A diet of fast food leads to a legacy of posterior facial hair.

line: The Foliage of Shame, Clog: fast food leads to legacy of posterior facial hair.

card.name: The Squint-of Goggles
card.power: Misread: Interpret a Rule Card incorrectly on purpose. Opponents must prove you wrong.
card.lore: The future is bright. Too bad you can't see it.

line: The Squint-of Goggles, Misread: future bright. Too bad you can't see it.

card.name: The Phantom Waistline
card.power: Space Hog: Occupy two zones at once. Push others into the Void.
card.lore: Push people away, and you grow old alone. And by alone, we mean "wide".

line: The Phantom Waistline, Space Hog: push people away, grow old alone. And by alone, we mean wide.

card.name: The Toupee of Denial
card.power: Camouflage: Fail a stealth check. Everyone knows it's a squirrel.
card.lore: Graceful aging is a myth sold by hat salesmen.

line: The Toupee of Denial, Camouflage: everyone knows it's a squirrel. Graceful aging, myth sold by hat salesmen.

card.name: The Creaky-Knees Caliper
card.power: Rust: -5 to Agility. You can now predict rain with your joints.
card.lore: The mind wants to tango. The cartilage wants to crumble.

line: The Creaky-Knees Caliper. Rust. Predict rain with your joints. Mind wants to tango, cartilage wants to crumble.

card.name: The Bicker-of Bunker
card.power: Stalemate: Skip your turn to ensure your opponent also skips theirs.
card.lore: Seventy years later, we still haven't decided who gets the top bunk.

line: The Bicker-of Bunker, Stalemate: seventy years, still haven't decided who gets top bunk.

card.name: The Cookie of Causality
card.power: Inciting Incident: Restart the game from Turn 1. Keep all damage.
card.lore: The war didn't start over land or ideology. It started over a snickerdoodle.

line: The Cookie of Causality, Inciting Incident? Restart game, keep all damage. War started over snickerdoodle.

card.name: The Salad Dressing Divider
card.power: Petty Theft: Steal one resource. Claim it was yours for 40 years.
card.lore: Robots may inherit the earth, but they will still have to listen to us argue about condiments.

line: The Salad Dressing Divider, Petty Theft: claim it was yours for 40 years. Robots still listen to us argue about condiments.

card.name: The Unsent Apology
card.power: Regret: Take 10 Psychic Damage. Heal an opponent 10 HP.
card.lore: He died hating you. You win the argument, but lose the soul.

line: The Unsent Apology, Regret: he died hating you. You win argument, but lose soul.

card.name: The Strike-Forever of Sign
card.power: Filibuster: Talk uninterrupted for 60 seconds. If you stop, you lose.
card.lore: We will dismantle the establishment, even if we are decomposing while doing it.

line: The Strike-Forever of Sign. Filibuster. If you stop, you lose. Dismantle establishment, even if decomposing.

card.name: The Wheelchair Joust
card.power: Chivalry isn't dead, it's just on life support and very angry.
card.lore: Joust: Roll a d6. On a 1, you have a heart attack. On a 6, opponent dies.

line: The Wheelchair Joust: chivalry isn't dead, just on life support and very angry.

card.name: The Grudge-Tree
card.power: Entanglement: Bind yourself to another player. If you fall, they fall.
card.lore: Hope is for people who aren't stuck in a tree for 70 years with Harold.

line: The Grudge-Tree, Entanglement: if you fall, they fall. Stuck in tree 70 years with Harold.

card.name: The Loop of Blame
card.power: Recursion: Replay the last turn exactly as it happened. Blame the dice.
card.lore: It's your fault. No, it's my fault. No, it's your fault for making it my fault.

line: The Loop of Blame, Recursion: your fault. No, my fault. No, your fault for making it my fault.

card.name: The Skeleton of Waiter
card.power: Hold Music: Force an opponent to hum a tune while you think. If they stop, they skip a turn.
card.lore: Madame Foster is just finishing up. She's been in the craft aisle for three decades.

line: The Skeleton of Waiter, Hold Music: Madame Foster just finishing up. In craft aisle for three decades.

card.name: The Slide of Eternity
card.power: Gravity Trap: You cannot leave this card until you roll a double.
card.lore: The ride ends when you die. Please keep arms and legs inside the existential dread.

line: The Slide of Eternity, Gravity Trap: keep arms and legs inside existential dread.

card.name: The Unanswered Riddle
card.power: Analysis Paralysis: Force a player to answer a trivia question. If they hesitate, they freeze.
card.lore: If you win, you have to keep playing. The only winning move is to be wrong.

line: The Unanswered Riddle, Analysis Paralysis: if you win, keep playing. Only winning move is to be wrong.

card.name: The Sock-Phone
card.power: Nonsense Call: Shout a random phrase. Any player who laughs takes damage.
card.lore: I made a brother! He smells like feet and listens to my screams.

line: The Sock-Phone, Nonsense Call: I made a brother! Smells like feet, listens to my screams.

card.name: The 40th Grade of Desk
card.power: Held Back: Negate a 'Level Up' card. You must repeat the tutorial.
card.lore: There is always next year. And the year after that. Mr. Ratburn is immortal.

line: The 40th Grade of Desk, Held Back: repeat tutorial. Always next year. Mr. Ratburn immortal.

card.name: The Safe Path of Grave
card.power: Caution: Skip your turn to gain +1 Defense. Bore your opponents to death.
card.lore: He never took a risk. His heart beat perfectly until the moment it died of boredom.

line: The Safe Path of Grave, Caution: heart beat perfectly until it died of boredom.

card.name: The Unfinished Script
card.power: Procrastination: Push any negative effect to the next turn. Repeat indefinitely.
card.lore: Art is 1% inspiration and 99% staring at a wall until you die.

line: The Unfinished Script, Procrastination: art is 1% inspiration, 99% staring at wall until you die.

card.name: The Participation Trophy
card.power: Validation: Gain 1 point for doing absolutely nothing.
card.lore: You showed up. That was the extent of your contribution to history.

opener: You with the card in your hand
line: The Participation Trophy, Validation: you showed up. Extent of your contribution to history.

card.name: The Pink Slip Robot
card.power: Automation: Replace your hand with a random algorithm (roll dice for actions).
card.lore: The future is efficient. You are not. Please vacate the premises.

line: The Pink Slip Robot, Automation: future efficient. You are not. Please vacate premises.

card.name: The Laser Cane
card.power: Tech Upgrade: +5 Attack, but you forget who you are attacking.
card.lore: In the year 2000, the hunt doesn't require aim, just batteries.

line: The Laser Cane, Tech Upgrade: you forget who you are attacking. Hunt doesn't require aim, just batteries.

card.name: The Gym Teacher's Hell
card.power: Payback: Reflect all damage taken in the early game back to the dealer.
card.lore: The weak shall inherit the gym, and the gym teacher shall inherit the hernia.

line: The Gym Teacher's Hell, Payback: weak shall inherit gym, gym teacher shall inherit hernia.

card.name: The Hover-Diaper
card.power: Levitation: Immune to Ground attacks. Vulnerable to Dignity attacks. Science conquered gravity solely to deal with incontinence.

line: The Hover-Diaper, Levitation: science conquered gravity solely to deal with incontinence.

card.name: The Garbage Kingdom
card.power: Scavenge: Draw cards from the discard pile. They smell bad.
card.lore: When the nanny throws you out, you become King of the Dump.

line: The Garbage Kingdom, Scavenge: nanny throws you out, you become King of Dump.

card.name: The Retainer Party
card.power: Isolation: You cannot be targeted by others. You also cannot win.
card.lore: Happy 100th Birthday. Your only friend is a piece of dental wire.

line: The Retainer Party, Isolation: Happy 100th Birthday. Only friend, piece of dental wire.

card.name: The Abyss Home
card.power: Institutionalize: Remove a character from play. They are 'safe' now.
card.lore: A nice place where the soup is warm and the doors are locked from the outside.

line: The Abyss Home, Institutionalize? They are safe now. Soup warm, doors locked from outside.

card.name: The Zero-G Rocker
card.power: Drift: Move in a random direction every turn. Ignore physics.
card.lore: Rocking back and forth is the only propulsion left.

line: The Zero-G Rocker, Drift: rocking back and forth, only propulsion left.

card.name: The Pearly Gatekeeper
card.power: Judgment: Reveal your hand. If you have any "Stolen Items", lose the game.

line: The Pearly Gatekeeper, Judgment: reveal your hand. Any Stolen Items, lose game.

card.name: The Empty Dance Floor
card.power: Nostalgia: Skip your turn to relive a better turn from the past.
card.lore: The music stopped forty years ago, but the feet keep moving.

line: The Empty Dance Floor, Nostalgia: music stopped forty years ago, but feet keep moving.

card.name: The Dream-Bubble Pop
card.power: Wake Up: Cancel all active "Future" effects. Return to reality.
card.lore: It was all a dream. A terrible, wrinkly, arthritis-filled dream.

line: The Dream-Bubble Pop, Wake Up: all a dream. Terrible, wrinkly, arthritis-filled dream.

card.name: The Reset Button
card.power: Meta-Strike: Drop a 16-ton weight on the Game Master.
card.lore: When the plot gets too depressing, complain to the writers until they drop an anvil.

line: The Reset Button, Meta-Strike: plot too depressing? Complain to writers until they drop anvil.

card.name: The Denial Visor
card.power: Effect: Block all 'Future' cards. If you can't see it, it isn't happening.
card.lore: The ultimate defense against reality.

line: The Denial Visor? If you can't see it, it isn't happening. Ultimate defense against reality.

card.name: The Grudge Anchor
card.power: Effect: Prevents a character from moving, changing, or growing as a person.
card.lore: Why move forward when you can stay here and be angry?

line: The Grudge Anchor: why move forward when you can stay here and be angry?

card.name: The Nap-Time Hammer
card.power: Effect: Force a 'Dream Sequence' turn skip on any player acting too energetic.
card.lore: For when the young people are being too loud.

line: The Nap-Time Hammer, Dream Sequence: for when young people are too loud.

card.name: The 4th Wall Brick
card.power: Effect: Allows player to rewrite the text of one card with a marker.
card.lore: Escape the medium.

line: The 4th Wall Brick: rewrite one card with marker. Escape medium.

card.name: The Fountain of Old
card.power: Field Effect: All movement speed is halved. Bathroom breaks double.
card.lore: Drink deep and feel your bones liquefy.

line: The Fountain of Old: bathroom breaks double. Drink deep, feel your bones liquefy.

card.name: The Memory Lane Minefield
card.power: Field Effect: Every step deals Psychic Damage based on past embarrassments.
card.lore: Watch your step. That's where you called your teacher 'Mom'.

line: The Memory Lane Minefield: watch your step. That's where you called your teacher Mom.

card.name: The What-If Window
card.power: Field Effect: Looking through it causes 'Depression' status.
card.lore: Look at the life you could have had. Now look at your hand. Cry.

line: The What-If Window, Depression: look at life you could have had. Now look at your hand. Cry.

card.name: The Paradox Playground
card.power: Field Effect: Time flows in reverse. Winners become Losers.
card.lore: Fun for the whole family, assuming the family hasn't been erased from existence.

line: The Paradox Playground: time flows in reverse. Fun for whole family, assuming family hasn't been erased.

card.name: The Glitch-Beast
card.power: Chaos: Shuffle all discard piles into a new deck. Draw 5.
card.lore: It hurts to exist.

line: The Glitch-Beast, Chaos, shuffles all discard piles into new deck? It hurts to exist.

card.name: The Eraser
card.power: Delete: Physically tear up one card from an opponent's hand.
card.lore: The only permanent cure for aging.

line: The Eraser, Delete: tear up one card. Only permanent cure for aging.

card.name: The Blank Cheque
card.power: Bluff: Pretend you have a winning card. If no one calls you out, you win.
card.lore: Value is subjective.

line: The Blank Cheque, Bluff? Pretend you have winning card. Value subjective.

card.name: Uncle FrizzleBob's Exit
card.power: Resign: Flip the table. Go outside. Play outside.
card.lore: Game Over. You're still old. Go home.

line: Uncle FrizzleBob's Exit, Resign: flip table. Go outside. Play outside. You're still old. Go home.
